quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: The company said on SSE e-Interactive: its SiC products serve new-energy vehicles, charging piles, PV and storage, data-center / AI server power supplies, UPS, industrial automation, humanoid robots, AI/AR glasses and white goods.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Optical business: H1 2026 optical revenue grew substantially and profitability improved; optical products serve access networks, data communication, telecom transmission, AI compute, automotive, commercial aerospace, consumer and industrial markets, and customers are mainly downstream module makers. The InP substrates the company uses are bought in; it has stable cooperation with mainstream domestic and overseas suppliers, deliveries are normal and purchases meet production needs.

quarterly_data.quarter: Sanan Optoelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-14-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: LED: in H1 2026 the company pushed higher-value Mini/Micro LED, automotive, commercial aerospace and horticultural lighting products, raising the share of high-end products and lifting LED revenue steadily.

Sanan Optoelectronics.why: Makes SiC substrates, epitaxy and power chips (Hunan Sanan) and supplies 8-inch SiC substrates to its Anyifa SiC joint venture; SiC power devices go into data-center / AI server power supplies, EV and storage.
Sanan Optoelectronics.evidence: Sanan Optoelectronics investor Q&A: SSE e-Interactive (09-11-2026): Hunan Sanan has 6-inch SiC capacity of 16,000 wafers/month and 8-inch 1,000 wafers/month; Chongqing Sanan's 8-inch SiC substrate capacity of 60,000 wafers/year is expanding to meet Anyifa's substrate demand.
